pages.title: Blue Ice Singularity
pages.text: Blue ice compacted into a single point so cold it frosts the air around it. Normal ice melts; this does not. It is perfectly clear and blue, and slides across any surface with no friction at all. Water that touches it freezes instantly into perfect hexagons.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Blue ice is ice compressed until the bubbles are gone. Compressing it further in the Singularity Compactor gave me a single, freezing point that refuses to melt.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
